title: Alleged Assassination Plot Against PM Tusk and Defense Minister Kosiniak-Kamysz Uncovered
detail: Polish authorities uncovered an alleged assassination plot targeting Prime Minister Donald Tusk and Defense Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz. The Internal Security Agency (ABW) is leading the investigation into the alleged conspiracy, which marks a severe escalation of political violence risk inside a frontline NATO state bordering Ukraine. Details on suspects and potential foreign links are emerging as the investigation proceeds.

media.caption: Le Monde reports on alleged assassination plot against Polish PM Tusk and Defense Minister Kosiniak-Kamysz
